thread:
devon: Quick follow-up from INC-4321 postmortem. We promised concrete test artifacts and owners. Ill toss proposals here; please ack and claim.

maria: Ack. Suggest we split into three deliverables: (A) incident-driven regression promptset, (B) KV eviction load test, (C) scoped chaos game-day. I can take (A). :raised_hands:

kevin: Ill take (B). Plan: k6-style job that ramps to ~900-1k RPS for 30m and injects periodic heavy GC/eviction to exercise cache misses. Capture p95/p99 and eviction counts.

priya: Ill coordinate the chaos game-day (C). Proposed slot: 2025-02-20 09:00-12:00 UTC in staging. Drill will include network delay to cache tier, node drains, and forcing model-variant fallback.

alex: I can pair with maria on the promptset. We should measure both exact-match failures and semantic similarity regressions, plus a regeneration check.

maria: Sounds good. I'll author the first draft of 200 prompts covering: short-context hallucinations, kv-miss contexts, retry scenarios, and tokenization edge cases. Add to nightly CI and on-deploy for Dedicated.

kevin: Early k6 snippet to iterate on: 
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://staging-inference.redwood/api/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'test prompt'}), { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
  sleep(0.01);
}
```
Will add header variants and longer sequences to force KV pressure. Also will flip fallback routing to small-LLM during some runs.

priya: For the game-day runbook, need owners on: injects (infra), monitoring watch (sre), rollback path (platform), and comms. Can someone own the monitoring checklist?

sre-oncall: I can own monitoring watch for the drill. Add auto-escalation if tail-latency > 500ms for >=5m or error-rate > 1% sustained for 3m. Ill prepare a monitoring playbook entry.

devon: Summarizing owners/trackers: maria = promptset (TKT-7921), kevin = KV load test (TKT-7922), priya = chaos drill coord (TKT-7923), alex = promptset pairing (TKT-7924). Targets: maria 2025-01-31, kevin 2025-02-07, priya drill 2025-02-20. Confirm or raise changes.

alex: Confirmed on pairing. I'll help define evaluation metrics: exact-match threshold 90% for canned answers, embed-sim > 0.78 for semantic checks as baseline (will tune).

maria: CI job name: `regression/incident-4321/promptset`. I'll open PR today and include gating threshold and a workflow to run nightly and on deploy to dedicated.

kevin: TKT-7922 created; linking to dashboard `eviction-kv/incident-4321`. Will add Grafana panels for p50/p95/p99, eviction rate, and fallback counts.

evals-bot: Note: New evals created: `incident-4321-promptset` (CI: nightly + pre-deploy), `incident-4321-kv-load` (staging scheduled). Details: https://evals.redwood/internal/4321

devon: Thanks. I'll update the postmortem with owners and due dates and set a biweekly reminder. Let's reconvene in two weeks for status. :thumbsup:
